event.overheard_dorian_hazel_2.l1.text: My old mushroom guide. Pressed leaves inside. Eight falls of them.
event.overheard_dorian_hazel_2.l1.why: nine falls duplicated Ione's nine-year slips; hinge words 'pressed leaves' untouched

event.dorian_heart8.after.text: {if choice:notebook.praise}You said lovely. The next page is yours. I'll draw you as a mushroom.{else}{if choice:notebook.ask}The brown one's yours. Don't lose it. I'll miss it. A little.{else}Your mushroom lives in the notebook now. Crooked. Four hundred and thirteen.{/if}{/if}
event.dorian_heart8.after.why: pays off the canon 412 count and removes the page-one contradiction; drops a repeated 'Perfect.' (birthday r2 owns it)

threads.dorian_heart2: There is a deeper place he will not show yet; the moss is still deciding.
threads.dorian_heart5: Nobody ever asked how far Edmund got counting the trees.
threads.story_notes_dorian: Three more doors get notes before dark, and the player must not follow or guess whose.
threads.story_pumpkin_dorian: Next fall Dorian grows his own pumpkin; the pumpkin, at least, has not forgiven him.
threads.dorian_heart8: The notebook is open now; the next drawing, or number four hundred and thirteen, belongs to the player.
threads.dorian_birthday: A small thing of the player's now lives in his quiet: kept words, the second ridge, or a pinecone on his shelf.
threads.dorian_courtship: Tomorrow's walk, no talking until the third tree — and what gets said after it.
threads.dorian_courtship2: The answer can still be 'longer'; Dorian is learning patience from the oak.
threads.dorian_partners: Past the third tree now; the feather lives by the notebook, and he owns three good things.
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_1: Marcus saves his shortest words for Dorian; twelve words a week is a friendship.
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_2: The best hour of the week is a silent one; the plane is still waiting.
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_3: The first door Dorian would close on purpose stays open, mostly — for whom?
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_4: The owl has not told Dorian its name yet.

notes: reading_night verified: my snowdrop-and-lamp line stands and Ione's echo ('A snowdrop, for the lamp') and 'one more chair' both hold; no change needed on my side.

Notebook count four hundred and twelve confirmed in dlg.dorian.notebook.1; the heart8 draw branch now continues the count to four hundred and thirteen, so any future count must start from there once choice.notebook.draw is set.
The 'practiced' run (heart8 intro, courtship intro, courtship2 intro) is a deliberate escalation — he rehearses the speeches that matter — not wallpaper; please keep the scene order.
story_scarecrows: Tilda's r0 and my r1 both say 'Take the runner-up home.' Parallel branches, the player sees only one; left as is, but the Director may want Tilda to vary hers.
Hazel's reading_night parenthetical uses a one-word 'Deciding.' — same personification shape as my heart2 fox/moss lines. Harmless as a single brush; flagging so it does not spread.
